title: Agent-as-a-Judge
abstract: arXiv:2611.18067v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Artificial intelligence has progressed from task-specific systems toward general models spanning perception, generation, reasoning, and autonomous interaction, making reliable evaluation essential for comparison, deployment, and post-training feedback. At scale, modern evaluation pipelines increasingly rely on LLM-as-a-Judge to produce scores, preferences, and critiques; in its fixed-context setting, the judge relies on the supplied evaluand and evaluation materials. Yet a reliable verdict may require evidence beyond the supplied evaluand and context---either because critical environmental states remain unrecorded in the static execution log, or because controversial factual claims require external verification. Passive judges cannot obtain that missing evidence before deciding, especially when evaluating agent trajectories, executable artifacts, or domain-specific reports. translated_abstract: 人工智能已从面向特定任务的系统发展为涵盖感知、生成、推理与自主交互的通用模型，这使得可靠的评估对于模型比较、部署以及训练后反馈变得至关重要。在大规模场景下，现代评估流程日益依赖“大语言模型即裁判”（LLM-as-a-Judge）来生成评分、偏好与批评意见；在固定上下文的设定中，裁判仅依赖所提供的被评估对象和评估材料。然而，一个可靠的裁决可能需要超出所提供材料与上下文之外的证据——这可能是因为关键的环境状态未被记录在静态执行日志中，也可能是因为存在争议的事实性声明需要外部验证。被动的裁判在做出判断之前无法获取这些缺失的证据，尤其是在评估智能体轨迹、可执行产物或领域特定报告时。因此，近期的工作开发了能够主动搜寻缺失证据的主动式评估器……
tldr: 该论文提出“智能体即裁判”新范式，让评估器能够像智能体一样主动搜集固定上下文之外的缺失证据（如未记录的环境状态和需要外部核验的事实性声明），从而对AI系统做出更可靠的评估裁决。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Agent-as-a-Judge paradigm, in which the evaluator acts as an agent that actively seeks missing evidence beyond the fixed context, enabling more reliable verdicts when evaluating AI systems.
